caption: CLI Agent
description: An agentic CLI observed by Agent Journal, extending the core ai_agent. product identifies the CLI product and version; name is the product name; version is the CLI version; instance_uid is the native session id; uid is set only when a source reports a stable logical agent identity. Launch settings and source references belong to the run manifest and source_ref, not to this object.
name: cli_agent

product.description: The CLI product and version that produced the observed records.

instance_uid.description: The native session identifier of this invocation.
